abhts_15.1.literal: But-when (yadā punar) [is] of-near-death-one (āsannamaraṇasya) by-self (svayam) or-through-kin-mouth (bandhumukhena vā) descent-arisen (śaktipātaḥ upajāyate) — then (tadā) for-him (asmai) [is] instant (sadyaḥ) upward-leaping-initiation (samutkramaṇadīkṣām) [one should] do (kuryāt)
abhts_15.1.note: | bulk-confirmed (ralph loop, T1 frozen, owner bless covers method)
